children: Dutch Bros chose not to increase its offer for up to 65 Salad and Go sites across Arizona, Nevada, Oklahoma and Texas. The company says it remains engaged in the process but won't stretch beyond its original bid. Chief Executive Officer Christine Barone says the company has always been disciplined in capital allocation and will pursue opportunities only where the total investment provides the appropriate return. Dutch Bros maintains its target of 2,029 shops by 2029, with new shop growth a key pillar of its long-term strategy.
